pre.name: scope
pre.prompt: Read the correction summary and the prior review evidence. Identify what changed since the last head. Write a brief scope note to scope.md.

team.name: findings
team.prompt: Re-check each finding from the prior review against the corrected head. Report any finding that is not resolved. Write findings to findings.md.

team.name: regression
team.prompt: Run the repository's full test suite and the plan's broader verification on the corrected head. Report any regression or failure. Write findings to regression.md.

post.name: synthesize
post.prompt: Synthesize findings.md and regression.md into reverify.md. State PASS or FAIL with evidence. Do not lower the bar to make it pass.
